KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.

2. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. pana
   B. fupi
   C. zito
   D. nene

3. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. mato
   C. kitoto
   D. watoto

4. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.

5. When practising Huyo na Hao, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Huyo na Hao.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Huyo na Hao.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Huyo na Hao.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Huyo na Hao.

6. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.

7. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   B. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.

8. When practising Anga, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Anga.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Anga.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Anga.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Anga.

9. When practising herufi kubwa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding herufi kubwa.
   B. Use insults to “practise” herufi kubwa.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for herufi kubwa.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to herufi kubwa.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Lishe Bora and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Kusoma: Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Nimpendaye and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain thi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hili na Haya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Nambari 11-50 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
